name: GitHub Workbench
description: Automate GitHub PR review and issue handling in Paseo: poll repos, dispatch agents into worktrees with an editable pre-dispatch panel (prompt, agent/model, thinking effort, permission mode), follow up new comments in the original agent, then merge or comment back.

zh-CN.name: GitHub 工作台
zh-CN.description: 在 Paseo 中自动化 GitHub PR 评审与 Issue 处理：轮询仓库、派发前可在面板编辑提示词与 agent 配置（agent/模型、思考档位、权限模式），新评论复用原 agent 跟进，再合并或评论回写。
